Privacy Policy

Last updated: June 2026

Gunners Den ("we", "us") is an independent Arsenal FC fan site. This policy explains how we handle data when you visit our site.

Advertising — Google AdSense

We use Google AdSense to display advertisements. Google may use cookies and similar technologies to serve ads based on your prior visits to this or other websites. You can opt out of personalised advertising by visiting Google Ad Settings. Third-party vendors, including Google, use cookies to serve ads based on a user's prior visits.

Cookies

We use localStorage to save your subscription status, site preferences, and cached news feeds. No personally identifiable information is shared with third parties by us. Google AdSense and RSS feed providers may set their own cookies.

Data We Collect

When you subscribe, we store your name and email address in your browser's localStorage and in our secure cloud database (GitHub Gist) so we can recognise you across devices. This data is not shared with third parties. You can request removal at any time by contacting us via our social channels.

External Links

This site links to external news sources (BBC Sport, Sky Sports, ESPN, Just Arsenal, Arseblog). We are not responsible for the privacy practices of those sites.

Contact

For privacy queries, contact us via our social channels. Gunners Den is not affiliated with Arsenal Football Club.
